timeline: How did RMS Olympic survive 24 years of service from 1911 to 1935 while her sister ship Titanic sank on her maiden voyage?
She was the lead ship of her class.
Built by Harland and Wolff in Belfast.
She earned the nickname Old Reliable.
First, she collided with a British warship.
The heavy impact tore open her starboard side.
Then she struck an iceberg and lived.
During war she became a troopship.
She even rammed a German U-boat.
The submarine sank beneath her steel hull.
She served successfully through the nineteen twenties.
Until the Great Depression made her unprofitable.
She was finally sold for scrap in nineteen thirty-nine.
